summary_1line: Vaisampayana recounts Vyasa’s divine origin and teaches that diverse spiritual systems ultimately point to Narayana as the supreme Purusha.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the golden mountain Vaijayanta rising from the Ocean of Milk, four-faced Brahma sits in meditation as the three-eyed Siva descends from the sky and bows at his feet.
Brahma lifts the prostrating Mahadeva with one hand upon the shining summit of the mountain surrounded by the luminous ocean.
